verdict.rationale: Quo documents shared team numbers, message history that can be filtered by contact, call history, and transcribed and summarized calls, which together suggest per-contact communication history visible to a team. The evidence never explicitly shows a unified contact thread combining calls and texts, nor contact notes that teammates can see; the per-contact retrieval is described through the MCP/agent interface rather than the core app. Missing for 10: explicit unified call-plus-text threading under a contact, shared contact notes, team-wide visibility of contact history in the app, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a sales lead, calls and texts thread under a contact with notes and history the whole team sees

citations.quote: Share one number and stay aligned with your team
Pull message history from any Quo inbox, filter by contact, date, or topic
Retrieve call history and voicemail transcripts from your Quo number.
Recorded calls come back transcribed and summarized, so no detail is missed and nobody has to take notes.
